# Comfy Vidu Q4 Preview- Reference to Video

Generate expressive videos from two reference images using Vidu Q4 Preview, a flagship model built for vivid character performance, dynamic camera language, and striking visual effects. Ideal for character-driven storytelling, cinematic action sequences, and effect-heavy scenes with explosions, smoke, or particles. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_vidu_q4_preview_r2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.reference_images: 5-second stylish 3D cartoon using both reference images. Preserve the fuzzy yellow character from image 1 and the white-haired character, purple smiley sweater and drink cup from image 2. Place them in one playful blue-and-purple world. 0–1s: The white-haired character takes a sip; a tiny yellow blur streaks past behind him. 1–2s: Hard cut to a low angle as the fuzzy character lands, squashes flat for a beat, then springs high with an exaggerated stretch. 2–3s: Whip cut to the white-haired character’s face—his eyes widen, he leans back, then grins. 3–4s: The fuzzy character makes one fast curved leap toward his shoulder, with a brief hand-animated motion smear. 4–5s: It lands softly; the character raises his free hand and they strike a cheeky, perfectly timed freeze-frame pose. Snappy cuts, bold camera angles, expressive squash-and-stretch, polished character animation and fashionable purple-yellow-blue color blocking. Keep the cup steady and both designs consistent. No dialogue, extra characters, text or subtitles.
